archetypes.name: dyn-tally-parity
archetypes.rationale: Neutral rescue touches count, ledger, classification, and artifact parity.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed code-review and plan-review tally paths for parity. Focus on whether rescued neutrals avoid rejected and neutral counts while still preserving Result=neutral in vote tables. Check classification scope, ledger outcome, review-tally.env, and emit-tally rebuild behavior for drift. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-prompt-sync
archetypes.rationale: The rubric change propagates through generated reviewer prompt surfaces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the rubric, voting protocol, reviewer templates, generated agents, and pre-rendered prompt files for consistent neutral-rescue wording. Verify the generated outputs match the canonical templates and that voter-facing text does not imply inline acceptance changed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
